title: Books of account and financial statements

content.overview: Sections 128 to 137 require books, financial statements giving a true and fair view, board approval, and filing.
content.glance: Sections 128 to 137 require books, financial statements giving a true and fair view, board approval, and filing.
content.study: Books are on accrual and double entry and are kept for eight years. Financial statements follow Schedule III and accounting standards under s. 133. Consolidated statements are required where the company has a subsidiary, subject to exemptions. The board report under s. 134 includes the directors' responsibility statement. Filing is under s. 137.
